audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (1) The page never states the single most useful fact in this matchup: Counter Strike dodges INCOMING ATTACKS — basic attacks — not ability damage. Riot's text is explicit. The page instead says his E 'keeps blanking your Q autos and W hit' and 'dodges your Q autos and the hit at the end of W', which teaches the player to stop pressing everything rather than to lead with abilities and hold his autos. (2) 'your W unstoppable' in late and 'you eat the empowered hit unstunned' in wants.you[1]. Path Maker gives REDUCED DAMAGE while charging — no CC immunity — so it does not save you from Counter Strike's stun. (3) 'Q3 knock-up' again; Ntofo Strikes' second stack pulls.
audit.why: Counter Strike is 17 seconds at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in either kit at that level — and if the player knows it only eats autos, the correct play (throw Q and W into it, save your basic attacks for after it expires) becomes obvious. The CC-immunity error is the dangerous one: it tells him to charge W into an active Counter Strike and get stunned.

edits.before: Jax is even-ish at Level 1 but you actually own the first trading window once your kit comes online. The whole early game is his E Counter Strike — it dodges your Q autos and the hit at the end of W, then stuns you. So never throw a naked Q into his face when E is up; charge W slightly and release it after his E animation expires so your knockback-stun lands clean. At Level 3 with full Q-W you can W a committed Jax and Q3 him for the knock-up, and his short E means he can't dodge a stun he's already mid-leap on.
edits.after: You own Level 1 outright — Jax has only Leap Strike and nothing to punish you with. The whole early game is his E Counter Strike, and the key is that it dodges basic ATTACKS, not abilities: it is 17s at rank 1, so throw Q and W into it freely and hold your autos until it expires. Release W after the dodge window ends so your knockback-stun lands clean. At Level 3 with full Q-W you can W a committed Jax and Q3 to pull him, since he can't dodge a stun he's already mid-leap on.

edits.before: This is where you reclaim it. Jax wants the side-lane 1v1, but a control-tank K'Sante with two items doesn't lose the lane and, more importantly, doesn't have to — your job is R All Out in teamfights, dashing through Jax and recall-dragging him off your carries before his on-hit DPS deletes them. He can still out-duel you in an isolated splitpush, so don't island-fight a fed Jax under his tower; group, peel, and let his single-target threat get neutralized in the 5v5 where your W unstoppable and R peel win.
edits.after: This is where you reclaim it. Jax wants the side-lane 1v1, but a control-tank K'Sante with two items doesn't lose the lane and, more importantly, doesn't have to — your job is R All Out in teamfights, dashing through Jax and recall-dragging him off your carries before his on-hit DPS deletes them. He can still out-duel you in an isolated splitpush, so don't island-fight a fed Jax under his tower; group, peel, and let his single-target threat get neutralized in the 5v5 where your W stun and R peel win.

notes: The best fact this page was missing: Counter Strike dodges INCOMING ATTACKS — basic attacks — not ability damage, and it is 17 seconds at rank 1. That turns 'respect his E completely' into a concrete rule: throw Q and W into it, hold your autos until it expires. The page previously told the player his E blanks 'your Q autos and the hit at the end of W', which is the opposite instruction. Also corrected the recurring 'W unstoppable' fabrication (Path Maker gives reduced damage while charging, not CC immunity — it will not save you from the Counter Strike stun) and the 'Q3 knock-up' wording. Four chart rows contradicted the packet and the whys beside them; flipped as matched pairs. The packet's suspectName note on the mirror ('Hold Counter Strike') was a false positive and there is nothing to fix on this side.
